instruction.text: Match each term with its definition.

atoms.b: when someone is trying to force you to do something.
atoms.sound: Pressure is when someone is trying to force you to do something.
Consent is agreeing or giving permission.

instruction.text: What actions might make you feel under pressure? Select the three correct answers.

b: ++someone calling you a baby if you’re too scared to do something
++someone trying to rush you if you’re taking a long time
++someone accusing you of being a bad friend if you say no
someone asking you how your day has been
someone recommending their favourite film to you

instruction.text: Which words or phrases show if we’re giving consent or not? Drag the words to the correct group.
Which secrets should we keep and which should we tell to an adult? Drag the types of secrets to the correct group.

atoms.b: a stranger online asking to meet up

atoms.a: When should you tell someone’s secret to an adult?
b: if it’s something funny
++if they’re being hurt
++if they’re doing something wrong
never

atoms.a: What should you do if someone is putting pressure on you to do something you’re not okay with?
b: ++say no
++tell an adult
just go along with it
hit them in the face
++situations that directly affect you
++when you might not be comfortable with something
your friend going the bathroom
whether you go to school or not

atoms.a: What should you do if your friend has told you a worrying secret?
b: ++tell a trusted adult who can help
++remember that it’s better to not keep this kind of secret
keep quiet about it and stay worried
tell all your classmates about it
